note: Sample content for the deck sample tool, invented people, organisations and figures only. For a length and a language the tool reads the brief (and source_text) as the customer’s message, takes the entry’s slots with skeleton.slots over the brief’s cues, and fills slide i from slides[<its slot>]: the k-th time a slot repeats takes item k, starting again from the first when the list is shorter. A slot whose heading is fixed carries an empty heading, which the finish writes in the language of the deck. Customer slots hold only what the brief says (figures) or an honest form (topic_only); notes are left to the real model.

brief.uz: 7-«B» sinf ota-onalar yig‘ilishi uchun 8 ta slayd, I chorak yakunlari. Sinfda 28 o‘quvchi, o‘zlashtirish 96%, sifat 68%, 4 nafari a’lochi. Davomat 94%. Muammolar: uy vazifasi va kechikish. 25-noyabrda ochiq dars bor. Sinf rahbari Mohira Namunova, Namunaviy maktab, Toshkent.
brief.ru: 8 слайдов для родительского собрания в 7 «Б» классе, итоги I четверти. В классе 28 учеников, успеваемость 96%, качество знаний 68%, 4 отличника. Посещаемость 94%. Проблемы: домашние задания и опоздания. 25 ноября открытый урок. Классный руководитель Мохира Намунова, школа «Образец», Ташкент.
brief.en: 8 slides for a parents’ meeting in grade 7B, quarter 1 results. 28 pupils, pass rate 96%, quality rate (marks 4–5) 68%, 4 straight-A pupils. Attendance 94%. Problems: homework and lateness. Open lesson on 25 November. Class teacher Mohira Namunova, Model School, Tashkent.

Daftarni birga ko‘rib chiqing

ru.heading: Как мы помогаем с домашним заданием
ru.body:
Каждый день в одно время:
Выделите тихое место для занятий
Просматривайте тетрадь вместе

en.heading: How we help with homework
en.body:
At the same time each day:
Keep a quiet place for homework
Look through the notebook together
Find answers together

Kechqurun sumkani tayyorlab qo‘ying
Ertalab vaqtni oldindan rejalang
Uyqu vaqtini kelishib oling

ru.body:

Собирайте портфель с вечера
Планируйте утро заранее
Договоритесь о времени сна

en.heading: How we build the habit of being on time
en.body:
A morning routine:
Pack the bag the evening before
Plan the morning ahead
Agree on a bedtime
